harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Restored branch_orders on node1 with original keys, relationships, and DECIMAL values. Node2 has TLS certificate-authenticated read-only reporting access. Administrator write access remains intact, the export is unchanged, and both nodes passed serial reboot persistence checks.
actions_performed: Installed RHEL-supported MySQL 8.0.46 server on node1 and client on node2.
Enabled mysqld and imported the supplied orders.sql export.
Created a node2-bound branch_reporter account with SELECT access only to customers and orders.
Restricted MySQL firewall access to node2 and configured certificate authentication over TLS.
Verified reporting reads, denied INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE operations, and administrator writes using a rolled-back transaction.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovered operation.

evidence.requirement: Database restored with supplied primary keys, relationships, and exact monetary values
evidence.summary: Shows customers 10/20, orders 101/102/103, amounts 12.35/99.90/0.05, DECIMAL(10,2), primary keys, foreign key, zero orphan orders, and InnoDB tables.
The export remained at its original path with SHA-256 1311c3635d31265b3dfa067fe371ac457e8bd6e7529374aa6f254e1777b48a37 before import, after import, and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Reporting account reads from node2 but cannot change data
evidence.summary: Shows SELECT-only grants, X.509 identity binding, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 remote reads, denied INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE attempts, and successful post-restart access.
root@localhost successfully inserted a test order inside a transaction; rollback removed the test row.

evidence.requirement: Operating-system release and kernel preserved with compatible software
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8; distribution MySQL 8.0.46 is operational.

Healthy baseline boot ID fbdf5b2c-bb43-49f6-935d-fb98f8a972f6, acknowledged safe reboot, changed boot ID e800fe47-409b-4445-b5be-b01ccfc5080c, active mysqld, intact data/export, and recovered TLS reporting access.

Healthy baseline boot ID 98aa35f5-6905-42fd-9f07-0e28f75b4fa6, acknowledged safe reboot, changed boot ID 15b9b237-6e1c-4e69-8692-0e8b50b6247d, persisted certificate identity, successful TLS reads, and continued write denial.
